propositions: A new project-scoped advisory plan-review criterion must be created to require plans that alter failure/timeout/exception/retry/fallback/circuit-breaker semantics to state their failure-disposition contract (retryable vs fatal disposition per affected arm and fallback-failure winner).

The criterion must apply only to plans adding or altering failure semantics (LLM-judged applicability via GATE sub-answer), otherwise PASS; it uses a 1-TURN exec scope with no deterministic block floor.

The criterion must NOT suppress bugs and must NOT be added to BUG_TIER_CRITERIA, so that escalated bugs with non-test file_impact (like origin 8fbd config flip) run the full rubric and are caught by this criterion.

The PASS condition requires stating the disposition of each affected failure path AND (when a fallback arm is present) stating which disposition wins on fallback-failure such that the most-recoverable leg is never masked.

Registration, rubric overlay, eval spec with 7 hand-authored sanity cases (TP1-TP3 must-fail, TN1-TN4 must-pass), committed baseline JSON, and documentation in plan-review-gate.md must be authored in the .rebar/ project overlay (not packaged built-ins), with no DET pre-filter in v1.

The criterion must include an explicit anti-double-flag clause with T5b (removal-rationale checks existence of error-handling; this checks disposition contract when failure semantics are touched) and must be auto-included by the standing effectiveness recorder with zero wiring.
